spec.text: Image 1 is the man's character model sheet; image 2 is the bridge and river for this scene; image 3 is the approved art style (sculpted matte clay figurines placed in a painted storybook set). Morning inside a city bus crossing the cable-stayed bridge from image 2: through the window behind him the single tall pylon, fanned cables and the wide river are visible. The man sits at a window seat in the CENTER third of the frame, his face turned toward screen-left, gazing far into the distance with a soft smile, as if looking at someone very far away. Every character is a dimensional sculpted matte clay figurine exactly like the people in the art-style image, about four heads tall, adult, never a flat 2D drawing; mouths closed in small gentle smiles. the man keeps EXACTLY his model-sheet look: black rectangular glasses, short swept black hair, navy cotton overshirt worn open over a white crewneck T-shirt, khaki chinos, white canvas sneakers, black backpack. Recreate any real place from the photos in the same warm matte clay and gouache storybook style. Cinematic composition. Any signs, plaques, screens or documents are blank; no readable text and no logos. No photorealism, no glossy plastic.
